integrity: Finite maxima and complete labelled orbit enumeration are reproducible from the included standalone Python checker. Unbounded bounds are established by the mathematical proof; finite computations are not promoted to an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact small-cap results hold for n=3,4 and m>=3, while the six-extremizer count is only for n=4,m=3. For n>4 the constructed lower bound is not asserted sharp; independent validation and comprehensive priority review are not performed.
title: Parity saturation and doubling in bounded-multiset Oddtown families
